verdict.rationale: 1Password publishes downloadable OpenAPI documents for its two REST surfaces: the Events API (OpenAPI 3.0.0, v1.4.1) and the Connect Server API (OpenAPI 3.0.2, v1.8.1). Both are linked from their API references, which render from these specs with an interactive playground. The 404s at support.1password.com's well-known OpenAPI paths only show the specs are not served at conventional discovery URLs; they do not contradict the hosted spec files. Missing for 10: specs covering the Service Accounts/SDK surfaces (documented as CLI/SDK-native without specs), discoverability at a well-known OpenAPI path, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the spec downloads.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: 1Password publishes the Events API as a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document (semver 1.4.1), linked from the Events API reference
The 1Password Connect Server API likewise ships a downloadable OpenAPI document (3.0.2, version 1.8.1), linked from the Connect API reference as the specification file.
